calculation_handling.description: A group home or residential care home must occupy the entire building and may not be combined with any other use.
calculation_handling.gaps: No vocabulary requirement for sole-occupancy of a building.

units.disclosure: The rule that a group home or residential care home occupies the entire building with no other use is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: In the Residential Zone category a group home may be in a building originally constructed as a detached house.
calculation_handling.gaps: Original construction type of existing buildings is not held.

calculation_handling.description: A group home may be in a building originally constructed as a semi-detached house if the lot is in the R zone and the group home occupies the entire building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Original construction type of existing buildings and whole-building occupancy are not held.

150.15.20.1(1).explanation: A group home or residential care home must take up the whole building and cannot share it with another use.

150.15.20.1(2).explanation: In the Residential zones a group home may be in a building originally built as a detached house, or as a semi-detached house if the lot is in the R zone and the group home takes up the whole building.
